name: Avernal Flashback
description: A phantasmal crimson worm appears to rampage outside the workshop, afflicting the area with phantom tremors, blistering heat, and cave-ins.
disable: DC 22 Athletics , DC 22 Occultism , or DC 22 Religion ; it takes three successful checks to weaken the haunt or erect supports that brace the ceiling. A PC who speaks Dwarven can attempt DC 22 Diplomacy (trained) checks to calm the phantasmal cave worm.
routine: (2 actions) Zogototaru uses 1 action to create a Tremor. With her other action, she either Exudes Heat or makes Rocks Fall, alternating between the two each round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Exude Heat
offensiveAbilities.description: Zogototaru breathes fire across Guldrege. Even from a distance, this makes the area blisteringly hot, dealing 3d6 Fire Damage damage to all creatures (Basic DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Rocks Fall
offensiveAbilities.description: Zogototaru's thrashing appears to crack the roof, dropping debris on a random creature in the area. This deals 4d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 22 Reflex Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Tremor
offensiveAbilities.description: Zogototaru's thrashing shakes the ground, knocking creatures Prone in the area unless they succeed at a DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save.
